source_notes: D25 signal-only historical pool; outcomes already historically computed at D25, so NEVER describe prospective OOS. New ticker-disjoint from L/Q/R only, no assurance unobserved by any other previous study.

policies.E0: next day market open full 100% S0 or S1 (where available)
policies.E1: near close 0..3% above locked support -> next open <=support*1.05; full 100%
policies.E2: E1 first 50%; second 50% next open <=support*1.08 after two closes above support and later close rising; no averaging down
policies.E3: near close retest then later rising close confirmation -> next open <=support*1.08; full 100%

fill_model: open-only; pending created after prior closing; if open above cap: no fill even if low <= cap. Conservative fill at cap; optimistic fill at actual open.
exit: close below locked support at day t -> next trading day OPEN; D30 last bar below support marked late_stop not executed
report: Both per-signal including cash and per-traded plus n traded and cash exposure; A and D separate; S1 not applied to D.
